name: Continuous spread
structure: An unboxed continuous editorial spread: prose, large facts, flowing columns and marginal personal annotations share a single reading canvas. Avoid a two-column hero followed by numbered sections. Native vertical reading with an editorial contents index; wide type/columns collapse into a deliberately re-composed linear phone essay. No card slabs.

name: Court positions
structure: A full-bleed flat 2D basketball court is the information map. Actual matchup, player values, standings and editorial are anchored to distinct court positions, not placed in a dashboard below. Choose a zone to open a readable adjacent field-notes foldout. Phone shows the whole useful court with labelled targets and an inline detail region; no 3D/WebGL or Muse assets.

name: Horizontal chapters
structure: A horizontal chapter-based league publication with genuinely side-by-side, full-width destinations and explicit Previous/Next and direct chapter links. Native horizontal viewport movement, not a row of small cards above a long vertical dashboard. Chapters have different internal composition; phone navigates whole chapters with tap/swipe/keyboard equivalents. Allow readable vertical overflow inside each chapter.

name: Broadcast switcher
structure: A compact broadcast control room: a large focused program window, a narrow source slate and a persistent score rail. Choosing a source changes the program. The meaningful central view is a scoreboard/recap/personal field view, not an array of equal tiles. Mobile turns the slate into a source selector above one program. Keep all text readable, no auto crawl or fake live claims.

name: Semantic fact wall
structure: Actual facts form a spatial typographic field with scope-specific semantic zoom, nested context and return paths.

name: Chronological league feed
structure: A chronological league log: one visible time spine, dated events, completed-week evidence and current matchup annotations integrated by time. Filter by league/personal/market and source date. Different-width event entries flow around the spine, without bordered feed cards. Keep fixture Nov12 separate from Oct samples; phone uses a left spine. No invented dates or fake activity.

name: Working clubhouse
structure: Persistent side-on room with independently retained score wall, locker doors, bench leaves and local archive folders.

name: Head to head
structure: A true split-screen confrontation: own team and opponent each own one half, with a central scoring seam and synchronized comparative reading. Team facts, players and saved choice align across the seam. League-wide views replace the comparison with an explicitly different full-width reader. Phone gives a legible two-sided score then side tabs, preserving context. Not one matchup hero above a normal dashboard.

name: Branching season route
structure: Dated season route with independent local evidence branches, retained context and return at origin.

name: Quote bench
structure: Editable two-package planning bench with persistent memberships, honest totals and independent retained evidence.

name: Command index
structure: A search-first homepage made of a giant usable query field and an open typographic action index, then direct mixed team/player/action results in the same canvas. Empty search already has useful current facts and concrete task paths. Selecting a result expands an inline contextual answer; search is local, no AI or provider. Mobile keeps query/results at the center. Distinct from task-rail workspace: no persistent sidebar or pane grid.

name: Connected franchises
structure: Unfolding connected team territories with a shared comparison bridge, independent retained contexts and a pinned third team.

name: Folding atlas
structure: A folding atlas of full-width, unequal-height chapter spines. Opening a spine unfolds a large integrated spread in-place and collapses the prior spread, with visible contextual neighbours. This is navigation through an accordion book, not ten independent rounded cards. Default chapter is useful; keyboard/Escape/back restore. Phone retains strong spine shapes with a single readable unfolded chapter.

name: Parallel channels
structure: Four unequal vertical running channels, each a continuous unboxed thread (your team, league action, scouting, culture), with independent reading positions on desktop. Cross-links deliberately relate items across channels. Phone selects a channel with a visible all-channel index and remembers position. Avoid small bordered cards or a fixed central focus pane; the simultaneous parallel streams are the architecture.

name: Week planner
structure: A practical date/week planner as the homepage: current fixture week and dated editions occupy an actual schedule matrix with distinct all-day editorial lane and five matchup lanes. Selecting a scheduled item opens an attached agenda, not a dashboard sidebar on every section. Use only supplied dates/weeks, with explicit gaps. Phone is an agenda/calendar toggle with clear date context. No invented games or due dates.

name: League canvas
structure: Editable league composition: pin, move, remove and retain multiple actual franchise/roster/evidence materials; phone order remains editable.

name: League ledger
structure: A ledger-first, whole-page working data sheet: team and matchup rows, meaningful aligned columns, expandable inline subrows for rosters/personal evidence/editorial. No hero and no cards. Category index and sort/filter operate on the sheet itself. Desktop dense but readable; phone changes to labelled row records with a persistent column/field chooser. Distinguish nulls/zero and keep narrative source reading comfortable.

name: Evidence matrix
structure: Input-driven evidence comparison with pinned names, actual team ownership relations, source/unit/period distinctions and phone transposition.

name: Franchise index
structure: An alphabetic and numeric franchise field guide: a large open directory built from hanging team names, staggered approved portrait cutouts and precise locator marks. A–Z/rank index and roster search are primary; activating a franchise inserts a full-width in-flow dossier that pushes the index apart. Personal bookmark jumps to your actual franchise. No equal-card gallery, no sidebar workspace, no conventional hero.

name: Branching matchbook
structure: An authored branching matchbook: useful current matchup facts lead to explicit natural-language choices (inspect my players, compare teams, read the league, inspect prices). Choosing a branch expands a connected large-type decision path with readable actual evidence; breadcrumbs/back restore the parent and retain context. No chatbot typing, fabricated AI, search or task rail. Phone uses a vertical connected decision path; all destinations also accessible directly.
